newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BT interested in Belgium - papers.
newsitem.headline: BT interested in Belgium - papers.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is interested in competing in Belgium's domestic voice and data transmission market once the European Union telecommunications market is liberalised next year, Belgian newspapers reported on Friday citing BT officials.
"BT would like to be in a position to offer domestic voice and data services in Belgium," BT Belgium director Philip Lijmbach told L'Echo newspaper.
BT officials said, however, the company's plans would depend on the level of interconnection fees that state monopoly Belgacom SA would charge for using its infrastructure.
Details of the interconnection charges are due to be published by the end of June, in line with European Union directives on liberalising the telecoms sector.
According to L'Echo, BT estimates the Belgian telephone market will be worth 4.5 billion pounds sterling by 2000, up from 3.5 billion pounds in 1996.
